budget_items.topic: Shelter rents versus projection, eight months
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Shelter rents were projected at $156,157 for eight months and actually received $174,637, about $18,000 over.
budget_items.quote: eight months in rents projected at $156,157; actually received $174,637.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The authority reported a surplus of $3,518 and said it was doing well financially.
The healthy reserve was reported at 67.84%.

budget_items.topic: Maintenance overtime and COVID sanitizing costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Maintenance labor ran over budget due to COVID overtime, with maintenance coming in four times over the weekend for sanitizing; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: maintenance labor over due to overtime for covid, maintenance coming in four times over the weekend for sanitizing

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The authority is looking into receiving State funds for COVID expenses; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: we are looking into receiving funds from the state for covid expenses.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DHCD PHN 2020-29 describes how supplemental coronavirus funds will be distributed and documented; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: these funds are associated with any covid-related expenses.
